data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 shares mechanism with SRC_001: both use a direct positional counting argument—SRC_005 by the multiplication 9*9*8=648 (hundreds nonzero, tens distinct, units distinct) and SRC_001 by partitioning the complement into AAB/ABA/BAA positional forms—so the two mechanisms are duals (counting the valid set vs. counting its positional complement). It is refuted if SRC_001's AAB/ABA/BAA partition does not cover exactly the complement of SRC_005's 9*9*8 positional set, or if the AAA correction in SRC_001 is not the exact intersection of the three position-equality classes implied by SRC_005's distinctness constraint.
